specs.value: Submersible internal filter with transparent body, Venturi aeration and adjustable intake
Magnetic quick-release coupling (MCS), modular add-on chambers
Water flow adjusted from the bottom grid; Venturi and flow regulator on top; flow-ducting device included
Adds a 211 cm³ modular cartridge for chemical or biological media; can be converted into a fluid reactor for a sump

fits.fact: Works in both freshwater and marine tanks
The 400 is rated for tanks of roughly 10–35 gallons
The 800 is rated for tanks of about 130–200 L
Reviewers see it as a good fit for small tanks, quarantine tanks and setups with a moderate bioload
The intake opening can be made smaller so small fish and fry don't get sucked in
The 800 can also be used in a sump as a fluid reactor

usage.fact: The filter must be fully submerged. Use the top wheel to set the water flow and how much air the Venturi draws in
The magnetic coupling lets you pull off the media chamber with one hand for cleaning, without unclipping latches
The body is see-through, so you can tell by eye when the sponge is clogged and needs cleaning
You can attach extra modular chambers to hold more filter media
Unplug the filter before taking out the media to clean it

issues.fact: Many users say the Venturi air intake is the loudest part. Without it the filter is very quiet, and some owners use an airstone instead
A few owners say the outlet was noisy even with the air tube removed. Others suggest checking that the impeller is seated properly and free of debris
Noise can come back when evaporation lowers the water level around the filter head
Published flow ratings disagree: some shops list the 400 at 106 GPH and others at 136 GPH, so check the official figures
The 800 differs from the 400 and 600 by having the extra 211 cm³ cartridge and the fluid-reactor option

alternatives.why: Newer Sicce internal filter rated 700 l/h at 7 W; Sinh Cảnh Việt sells it for 1,000,000₫, more than the ADV 800
Same brand and also covered by a 3-year warranty; Greendeal sells it for 800,000₫ and it can be mounted horizontally or vertically
Stronger option for bigger tanks; Greendeal lists it at 1,200,000₫ with a 3-year warranty, but it was out of stock when checked
